title: Trade-in Bonus
description: Trade in your old smartphone or laptop and get an extra €50 on top of its trade-in value when you buy a new smartphone or laptop over €400.
eligibility: All customers trading in a working or repairable device

title: Accessory Bundle Deal
description: 10% off cases, chargers and screen protectors bought together with a new smartphone, when you order with your Cyberport customer account.
eligibility: Customers ordering with a Cyberport customer account

title: Student Laptop Discount
description: 10% off any new laptop, up to €150 off, with a valid student ID or university email address.

title: Business Volume Discount
description: 5% off orders of five or more laptops for business customers who order with a company name and VAT ID.
eligibility: Business customers with a VAT ID

title: Gaming Laptop Bundle
description: Get a free gaming headset with any gaming laptop over €1,000.

title: Refurbished Week
description: An extra 5% off all refurbished laptops.

title: 0% Financing
description: Spread purchases of €299 or more over 6, 12 or 24 months at 0% interest, subject to a credit check by our financing partner.
eligibility: Customers aged 18 or over, resident in Germany or Austria

title: Newsletter Welcome Offer
description: €10 off your first online order of €100 or more after signing up for the newsletter.
eligibility: New newsletter subscribers (first online order only)

title: Black Friday Week
description: Up to 20% off selected smartphones and laptops. Discounted products are marked in the shop.
